entries.title: Closed tasks no longer fill your other computers' disks
entries.body: When a task that ran on another computer closes, Infinitary brings its unmerged work to this Mac and then removes the task's working copy there. A task whose crewmate had checked out another version, as a reviewer does, kept its working copy there for good. Those copies are now removed once their work is saved here, including the ones already left behind.
entries.noPicture: This changes what Infinitary removes from a computer that runs work, not the layout or words of a screen.
